info.description: SMTP details and recipients for website form notifications. Admin-only — never exposed publicly.

enabled.description: Master switch. With this off no email is sent, but enquiries are still saved — so turning it off loses notifications, never submissions.

smtpHost.description: SMTP server, e.g. smtp.zoho.com, smtp.gmail.com, or your hosting provider's mail server.

smtpSecure.description: On for port 465, off for 587. Getting this wrong is the usual cause of a connection that hangs rather than errors.

smtpUsername.description: SMTP login, usually the full mailbox address.

smtpPassword.description: SMTP password or app password. Deliberately a string, not Strapi's `password` type: that one bcrypt-hashes the value, which makes it useless for authenticating to a mail server. `private` keeps it out of API responses.

fromEmail.description: From address. Must be one the SMTP account is permitted to send as, or the provider will reject the message.

recipientEmail.description: Where notifications are delivered. Comma-separate for several.

autoReply.description: Send an acknowledgement back to whoever submitted the form.
